name: Voxel Grid Initialization & Clamping
aliases: Voxel Grid Construction with Capacity Limits
definition: Initializes voxel grid dimensions, vertex counts, and boundary centers while enforcing hardware vertex limits through dynamic clamping.
summary: Voxel Grid Initialization & Clamping sets grid dimensions to fit within a maximum vertex budget, preventing GPU buffer overflows by prioritizing resource constraints over spatial mapping.
